privateCorpus.note: The owner-supplied corpus and its recorded parser refusals are unchanged. These licensed samples add no private-corpus credit and do not reopen owner acceptance.

samples.task: Fill a text field, select a choice option, check a checkbox, save, and reopen.
samples.expected: The text value, choice value and checked state persist; generated widget appearances contain the new values; the page count is unchanged.
samples.unsupportedBoundary: XFA is never authored, unsupported field kinds are refused, and orphaned widgets are reported rather than repurposed.

samples.task: Authenticate with the published password, rotate the page, save, and reopen with the same password.
samples.expected: The session is protected and editable, the saved file still requires its password, the AES-256 profile is retained, and the page rotation is 90 degrees.
samples.unsupportedBoundary: Only the supported AES profiles are covered; there is no password recovery, permission bypass, or owner-password substitution.

samples.license: MIT (project-generated test signature; independent CMS from openssl; Tests/Fixtures/Manifest.md)
samples.task: Validate the detached signature and attempt a normal content rewrite.
samples.expected: The signature is cryptographically valid with unsigned changes absent, and the writer refuses the rewrite instead of invalidating the signed document.
samples.unsupportedBoundary: Trust is unknown without an explicit owner anchor, revocation is not checked, and signed documents are not re-signed after content edits.

samples.task: Apply the documented transcription as a searchable layer, save, reopen, and search it.
samples.expected: The reopened page has a generated layer, the documented text is searchable with recognized-text provenance, and the original image bytes are unchanged.
samples.unsupportedBoundary: Recognition is supplied, not executed; Vision quality remains environment-dependent and this sample does not qualify OCR accuracy.

samples.task: Extract Greek, Cyrillic and Hebrew lines, save, reopen, and extract them again.
samples.expected: The same three lines and character order survive the write/reopen cycle, including the visual-order Hebrew line.
samples.unsupportedBoundary: The owned layout does not apply bidirectional reordering or claim full complex-script editing; this sample qualifies extraction and preservation only.

samples.task: Run the PDF/UA-oriented machine audit, save, reopen, and audit again.
samples.expected: No machine-checkable errors remain, the figure carries alternate text, the seven human-review requirements remain explicit, and the audit is unchanged after reopening.
samples.unsupportedBoundary: This is not a PDF/UA conformance claim; all seven human-review requirements, rendering and assistive-technology use remain outside the machine audit.
